title: Closure under polynomial-length verifier combination
statement: A verifier model $E$ is closed under the verifier combination if, for every verifier $M$ and all natural numbers $a,k,a',k'$, efficiency of the Boolean verifier associated with $M$ implies efficiency of the Boolean verifier obtained from $M$ using the polynomial lengths determined by $(a,k)$ and $(a',k')$.
hypotheses_covered: Natural numbers a, k, a′, and k′
Efficiency of the Boolean verifier associated with M
caveat: The construction named by the formal statement has no accompanying informal definition, so its role is described only through the polynomial lengths it receives.
